name: Guardant Health, Inc.
moat_justification: A genuine technology and evidence lead in liquid biopsy — Guardant360 profiling with new FDA Liquid CDx and companion-diagnostic approvals, and Shield as the first FDA-approved blood test for colorectal screening, now in ACS guidelines with first major commercial coverage — but no demonstrated pricing power or profitability, payer-by-payer reimbursement, and well-funded rivals (Exact Sciences, Natera, Roche/Foundation, Grail, Tempus) in every segment; the lead must be re-earned as sequencing costs and assay sensitivity move.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 7.1%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: High-growth liquid-biopsy leader, moat 5/10, but owner's earnings are negative in all of the last 5 years and on TTM (base -$3.27/share at $165.41) — Tier F on this screen; it does not clear 15% and no hurdle-clearing price is computable on a negative OE base.
moat_for: Guardant360 installed oncologist base and clinical-evidence depth, extended by FDA Liquid CDx and companion-diagnostic approvals
Shield first-mover in blood-based colorectal screening — FDA-approved, in ACS guidelines, first major commercial coverage
Reveal MRD / monitoring second growth leg on the same platform, plus biopharma & data partnerships
Platform scale lowering per-test cost (higher-throughput Shield workflow, sequencer transition)
moat_against: Competition in every leg — Exact Sciences (Cologuard), Natera (MRD), Roche/Foundation Medicine, Grail, Tempus
Reimbursement is payer-by-payer and policy-dependent; early-stage sensitivity limits keep tissue testing in place
No profitability at ~$1B revenue scale — returns on capital unproven and negative
Growth funded by shareholders — SBC rising yearly plus repeated equity / convertible issuance
